_notes: Data only. Poses live in answers.json (judge only). Each sketch belongs to a place and has alt text. hidden = the two outline pictures on the same page.

sketches.alt: A lighthouse seen between two pointed roofs. A fish-shaped weathervane on the left roof.
A shop counter with brass scales. A tall clock behind it. A birdcage hangs above.
A bridge made of old keys over dark ink. A tower of stamps behind. A cat's tail curls at the edge.
Three charms on a collar: a house, a bell, a heart. A whisker crosses above.
Three bright stars in a line. A curved gold ring crosses them. The corner of a window.
A small harbor far below, seen over a grey rim. A lighthouse on a stone pier.

lastPage.altStart: A grey moon with an old lamp. The lamp is dark.
lastPage.altEnd: A cat on a step, looking up at a glowing moon.
